instruction: Find the highest mark in the Marks row (C5:F5) and highlight that cell with any background color

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding max mark in C5:F5 and highlighting that cell. Evaluator dynamically identifies the cell with maximum value in range C5:F5 at runtime, then verifies that cell has background fill applied. Custom getter extracts all values in range, identifies max cell, and checks if it has fill. Custom metric verifies both conditions: (1) max value found, and (2) that cell has fill.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH requirements - (1) finds the highest mark in C5:F5 dynamically at runtime by iterating through all cells in the range, and (2) verifies that specific cell has background fill applied.

Dynamic runtime verification: Getter extracts all values in range C5:F5 and identifies which cell contains the maximum value at runtime (xlsx.py:64-78), not hardcoded to any specific cell. This correctly handles cases where user highlighted the wrong cell.

Correct logic flow: Getter loads workbook twice (data_only=True for values, data_only=False for formatting), correctly identifies max cell, checks fill properties. Metric verifies both max_cell is found AND max_cell_has_fill is true.
Robust edge case handling: Handles missing files, non-numeric values, empty data. Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save file before verification.
